text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Automated alert — elevated errors on /v1/generate. p95 2.1s -> 4.9s, p99 5.8s -> 7.2s in last 5m; 5xx rate 12%. Paging @Alyssa Chen (primary oncall) and SRE rotation.
Alyssa Chen: ACK. I'm looking at traces and k8s events now.
Devon Patel: On call too, I can help with gateway and traffic fixes. which revision rolled?
Alyssa Chen: It lines up with canary deploy rev=deploy-2026-03-15-88 around 10:40 UTC. Canary traffic was ~8% global.
Samir Roy: Gateways show lots of: `upstream response timeout while reading response header from upstream` and a backlog of keepalive connections.
Maria Gomez: CS: we've seen 5 enterprise customers open tickets with 502/504s — keeping them updated.
Alyssa Chen: Quick smoke: `curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` returns 504 consistently from us-west edge.

```
HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Time-out
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":{"message":"upstream timeout","code":504}}
```

Devon Patel: I'm pulling the canary pods logs: lots of repeated KV-cache warnings and long first-token latencies. Looks like a regression in connection pooling in the new runtime change.
ops-bot: Telemetry snapshot attached: traces: https://telemetry/redwood/trace/6111112222 (auto)
Alyssa Chen: Customer impact estimate: ~10-15% of requests to generate are failing or timing out for affected regions. High-impact for sync customers.
Devon Patel: Mitigation plan attempt 1: divert canary traffic back to stable routing (rollback traffic only) and scale stable pool x2. Doing traffic-shift now.
Devon Patel: `redwood traffic shift set --target=stable-model-1 --percent=100 --from=canary-model-88`
Alyssa Chen: ops: can we quick-scale the stable serving pool and increase connection limits on the gateway?
ops-bot: Running: `kubectl -n serving scale deployment stable-model-1 --replicas=20` and `kubectl -n gateway set env gateway --env=MAX_IDLE_CONNS=2000`
Samir Roy: I've also pinned the canary instances to cordon mode so they don't take new traffic while we triage.
Kyle (oncall-sre): taking over pager for followup once primary clears; leave notes here for handoff.
Alyssa Chen: After traffic shift and scale: p99 dropped from 7.2s -> 430ms within 90s, 5xx rate from 12% -> 0.9%. Looks promising.
Maria Gomez: CS: pushing interim note to affected customers, telling them we're rolling traffic to stable and will follow up with timeline.
Devon Patel: For root cause, I'll open a debug run against the canary runtime change and capture kernel-level traces. Samir, can you keep the canary pods quarantined and attach logs to the incident?
Samir Roy: Yep saving logs to /incidents/6111112222/artifacts and grabbing `strace`/tcpdump as well.
Alyssa Chen: Decision: do not full revert yet. We rolled traffic away from canary and scaled stable. We'll treat this as a partial mitigation (traffic diversion + scale). If errors reappear on stable, we will perform a full revert of deploy-2026-03-15-88.
incident-bot: Incident declared: SEV2 — "service-degradation: generate endpoint". Incident channel created: #incident-6111112222. Assigned: Alyssa Chen (lead), Devon Patel, Samir Roy, Maria Gomez.
Alyssa Chen: Handoff to Kyle in 15m for watch. I'll stay on for the next 30m to confirm stability, then hand status to Kyle.
Kyle (oncall-sre): Acknowledged. I'll watch dashboards and CPU/conn metrics, and pick up postmortem write.
Maria Gomez: I'll own customer comms and assemble a short status for affected customers and CS leadership.
Devon Patel: Root-cause debugging started; initial hypothesis: connection pooling change + memory pressure in canary runtime path causing head-of-line stalls. Collecting more traces.
Alyssa Chen: p95/p99 are stable now: p95 ~120ms, p99 ~430ms, 5xx under 1% across regions. Marking as mitigated for the live page. We'll keep the incident channel open for RCA.
Samir Roy: I'll draft the post-incident checklist and attach logs.
Alyssa Chen: Thanks everyone. If things stay green for 30m I'll drop the pager and we transition to a postmortem. :thumbsup:
Product_CS: Notifying product + support rotation to follow up with customers.
incident-bot: Pager transferred to Kyle (oncall-sre). Next update due 2026-03-15T11:10:00Z.
